flagged.evidence: The proof says, “For each $v>S$ ... hence $$\left|\frac{F(v)}v\right|\le\frac{|F(S)|}{v}+\varepsilon\frac{v-S}{v}.$$” Its stated choice only requires $S\ge v_0$, so it does not ensure $v>0$ for every $v>S$; the quotient is undefined at $v=0$, and division can reverse the bound when $v<0$. Restricting to sufficiently large $v>\max(S,0)$ repairs this immediately; the claimed limit is unaffected.
